games.name: Seeker vs Hider
games.desc:
Welcome to the Deadliest Game of Hide and Seek!

HIDERS: Stay hidden from the Seeker until the round ends. Once time runs out, it’s your chance to take the Seeker down and win!

SEEKER - Find all the Hiders before time runs out. If you don’t, it’s your turn to survive until the end and avoid being taken out!

Don’t forget to like, favorite, and join the group!

GAME IS IN TESTING. EXPECT BUGS AND SERVER MIGRATIONS

CONTROLS PC:
C/X - Crouch, Stand
R/M1 - Reload
F/M1 - Chamber
M1 - Fire
M2 - Aim
P - Ragdoll

CONTROLS CONSOLE:
A/X - Jump
B/⭘ - Crouch, Stand
X/☐ - Reload
Y/△ - Ragdoll
RT - Fire
LT - Aim
LeftJoyStick - Sprint 

This is a work of entertainment and should not be seen as a reference to or approval of real-world events.

Inspired by Shooter vs Hider, Hide or Die, Murder Mystery 2, Blood Debt, and more

⚠️CHEATING OF ANY FORM WILL RESULT IN A BAN ON ALL ACCOUNTS⚠️

games.name: [BLACK] Saiyan Battlegrounds

⭐ If you enjoy it, give it a like and add to favorites to encourage more frequent updates!

🎮 Controls:

Left-click: Execute powerful strikes with unstoppable ferocity to vanquish your enemies.

Game inspired by the Dragon Ball series and The Strongest Battlegrounds game
